about: Mixkit sound effects the vault keeps for itself (the cinetic kit's own are scripts/sfx-catalogue.json): what most videos reach for and the kit lacks, each picked by hand from Mixkit's category pages and heard with earshot (ear: the query it was taken for, its z and verdict). bun run fetch:sfx downloads them, bun run setup:sound files each into vault/sound/sfx/<category>/. Mixkit's terms (9j) forbid mass downloads of its library: this list stays hand-picked, each heard, with a few takes of one need so a film can vary them, never a crawl of a category.

licence.name: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License
licence.limits: use inside a larger work (a film); never redistribute the file on its own, as stock, in a tool or template; never register it with a rights-management service; no bots or scripts to mass download (terms 9j)
